t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Tall hats tend to pay out well. Switch up colour choices to see which is best. Don't forget the spacebar!

vb_textbox.text: The taller hats seem to pay out best but it is dependent on which colour is on the left or right. For example, on my go if a tall brown hat appeared on the left, the smaller hat on the right paid out better. So its trial and error really. Good luck!
